# Men Believed Laws Deciphered the Thoughts of the Almighty[^1]

When the first mathematical, logical and natural uniformities, the first _LAWS_, were discovered, men were so carried away by the clearness, beauty and simplification that resulted, that they believed themselves to have deciphered authentically the eternal thoughts of the Almighty.

[^1]: [[@Pragmatism - William James]]
